1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Render a captured hook log as a timeline: t+seconds, event, salient payload fields."""
3	import json
4	import sys
5	
6	NOISE = {"transcript_path", "cwd", "session_id", "permission_mode", "workspace_dir"}
7	
8	def brief(v, n=110):
9	    s = v if isinstance(v, str) else json.dumps(v)
10	    s = s.replace("\n", "\\n")
11	    return s if len(s) <= n else s[:n] + "…"
12	
13	def main(path):
14	    recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(path) if l.strip()]
15	    if not recs:
16	        print("(empty)")
17	        return
18	    t0 = recs[0]["t"]
19	    print(f"{'t+s':>8}  {'EVENT':<20} payload")
20	    print("-" * 100)
21	    for r in recs:
22	        p = r["payload"] or {}
23	        extra = {k: brief(v) for k, v in p.items()
24	                 if k not in NOISE and k != "hook_event_name"}
25	        hen = p.get("hook_event_name", "?")
26	        tag = r["declared_as"] if hen == r["declared_as"] else f"{r['declared_as']}(hen={hen})"
27	        print(f"{r['t']-t0:8.3f}  {tag:<20} {json.dumps(extra)[:400]}")
28	    print()
29	    print("=== distinct events fired ===")
30	    seen = {}
31	    for r in recs:
32	        seen.setdefault(r["declared_as"], 0)
33	        seen[r["declared_as"]] += 1
34	    for k, v in sorted(seen.items()):
35	        print(f"  {k}: {v}")
36	    print()
37	    print("=== full payload of first occurrence of each event ===")
38	    done = set()
39	    for r in recs:
40	        if r["declared_as"] in done:
41	            continue
42	        done.add(r["declared_as"])
43	        p = dict(r["payload"] or {})
44	        p.pop("transcript_path", None)
45	        p.pop("cwd", None)
46	        print(f"--- {r['declared_as']} ---")
47	        print(json.dumps(p, indent=2)[:2500])
48	
49	if __name__ == "__main__":
50	    main(sys.argv[1])
